# Weekly Scope Gating Skill

## When to use

- At the start of every weekly assignment task
- Before selecting any other skill

## Rule

Only implement what the current week explicitly requires.

## Workflow

1. Read the weekly requirements first.
2. Run a skill preflight at task start:
   - feature-branch-workflow
   - tdd-mastery
   - api-route-testing (if routes touched)
   - security-first
   - sequel-db-setup (if schema/models change)
   - markdown-linting (if any `.md` changes)
3. Map each requirement to existing skills.
4. Use only the minimum required skills.
5. Keep all other skills as reference only.
6. If a task is future-phase, record it as deferred roadmap work.
